exposure: use of nutrition screening and assessment tools (MNA-SF, SGA)
type of nutrition received (oral, enteral, none)
cohort: The study included 457 participants across 10 ICUs from a chain of urban private hospitals in India.
finding: It was common practice in Indian ICUs to use modified nutrition screening and assessment tools, and while most participants on enteral nutrition received planned calories, suboptimal delivery of enteral nutrition was observed, reflecting a global challenge in critical care.
